cells.label: fact
cells.reason: The passages describe Raymond James's own recruiting and retention approach, which is what the comparison sub-question asks about for this firm.

items.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options, referred to as AdvisorChoice®, through which financial advisors affiliate as employees, independent contractors, or as employees of third-party RIAs and broker-dealers served through its RIA and Custody Services division.
items.quote: We offer multiple affiliation options, which we refer to as AdvisorChoice®. Financial advisors primarily affiliate with us directly as either employees or independent contractors or as employees of third-party Registered Investment Advisors (“RIAs”) and broker-dealers to which we provide services through our RIA and Custody Services (“RCS”) division.

items.text: Raymond James prefers to recruit advisors one-by-one rather than through acquisitions, because 100% of transition assistance goes to retention of the advisor and it can ensure advisors are a good cultural fit.
items.quote: So we prefer to recruit 1 by 1 versus doing acquisitions because we know -- first, 100% of the transition assistance is going to retention of the adviser. And secondly, we can ensure that the advisers we're bringing over a really good cultural fits for the firm.

items.text: Raymond James offers loans to financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes, generally repaid over five-to-ten years and contingent upon continued affiliation.
items.quote: We offer loans to financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes. The decision to extend credit to a financial advisor is generally based on their ability to generate future revenues. Loans offered are generally repaid over a five -to- ten year period, with interest recognized as earned, and are contingent upon continued affiliation with us.

items.text: Raymond James's culture is rooted in values it pledges to clients, advisors and associates: put clients first, act with integrity, think long term, and value independence.
items.quote: Our pledge to clients, to our advisors, and to all of our associates is that: • we put clients first, • we act with integrity, • we think long term, and • we value independence.

items.text: Raymond James's advisor retention philosophy is to retain before it recruits.
items.quote: it goes back to how we think about adviser retention. You have to retain before you recruit.

items.text: Raymond James states it attracts and retains advisors with its culture, service and platform, whereas many competitors compete with the largest financial package.
items.quote: We attract and retain financial advisors with our unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check.

items.text: Raymond James participates, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting, which governs the client information advisors may take when moving firms and their ability to solicit prior-firm clients.
items.quote: We participate, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting (“Protocol”), a voluntary agreement among many firms in the industry that governs, among other things, the client information that financial advisors may take with them when they affiliate with a new firm and the financial advisor’s ability to solicit clients of their prior firm.

items.text: Raymond James's value proposition is that advisors do not have to choose between culture and capabilities, offering an advisor- and client-focused culture along with leading technology, products and solutions.
items.quote: advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture along with the leading technology, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

items.text: Raymond James recruits advisors broadly across all affiliation options rather than from any single firm or channel, and describes the pipeline as broad-based and not idiosyncratic.
items.quote: This is not a pipeline that is driven by one firm or one catalyst in the market or one affiliation option. It's a broad-based pipeline from many different -- advisers from many different firms and many different communities across the country interested in all of our -- the variety of our affiliation options.

items.text: Raymond James emphasizes consistency and a long-term approach to recruiting, rather than dialing recruiting up or down quarter-by-quarter, targeting advisors who want to stay long term rather than those moving for the highest compensation.
items.quote: it's a long-term process that requires a lot of investment, and if you dial up recruiting quarter by quarter or dial it down quarter by quarter, then you're not gonna get the quality advisors that you want. You're gonna get the advisors that are moving or not moving for the highest check, and that's not who we're targeting.

items.text: Raymond James reports recruiting and retention-related compensation for its Private Client Group, which it defines as expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with acquisitions.
items.quote: PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation includes expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions.
items.definition: PCG recruiting and retention-related compensation includes expenses related to cash and equity awards issued in conjunction with recruiting activities, as retention for existing advisors, or in conjunction with our acquisitions

items.text: Raymond James reported recruiting and retention-related compensation of $107 million for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, up 22% from $88 million in the prior-year quarter.

Raymond James reported record fiscal year 2025 recruiting results, recruiting advisors to its domestic independent contractor and employee channels with $407 million of trailing 12-month production, up 21% over the prior year, and approximately $58 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.quote: In fiscal year 2025, we had record recruiting results of financial advisors to our domestic independent contractor and employee channels, with recruiting trailing 12-month production at their previous firms totaling $407 million, reflecting a 21% increase over last year's previous record. These recruited advisors had approximately $58 billion of client assets at their previous firms.
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Raymond James states its domestic financial advisor retention remained very strong for the year ended September 30, 2025.
items.quote: For the year ended September 30, 2025, our domestic financial advisor retention remained very strong.
